description: Map a website's structure with Tavily, returning the URLs reachable from a starting page.

instructions.description: Natural-language guidance for which pages to include in the map.

limit.description: Maximum total number of URLs to return from the mapping.

max_breadth.description: Maximum number of links to follow per page or level during the mapping.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth of links to follow from the starting URL.

url.description: The starting URL to map the site structure from.

name: tavily-map
